# About Me

::: {.page-lead}
This space holds my writing on technical and non-technical topics — with a focus on clarity, rigor, and practical value.

::: {.page-content}
::: {.content-card}
Hi, I'm **Kelvin Ndeti**.

I write about mathematics, artificial intelligence, and philosophy. I'm interested in ideas that sit at the boundary of formal systems, minds, and machines — and in explaining them in ways that reward careful reading.

When I'm not writing, I'm usually building, learning, or thinking through a problem that refuses to stay simple.
